contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Tetricus II (272-274), possibly irregular issue, very worn. Obverse description: Radiate bust right, probably clean-shaven. Obverse inscription: [---]CVS. Reverse description: probably a figure ?standing left. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 1.84gms, die axis: possibly 6
